work.title: Alice Through the Looking-Glass
work.note: Alice Through the Looking-Glass é a continuação de Alice no País das Maravilhas, escrita por Lewis Carroll e publicada em 1871. pages.title: A white car · 1/3
paragraphs: It is six in the evening on a busy corner in Los Angeles. Bia looks at her phone and sees a white car. The car stops right in front of her. She checks the name and the plate number. A man in a blue cap rolls down the window. He smiles and says her name.
“Hi! Are you Bia?” says Omar. “Yes! You’re my driver, right?” says Bia. “That’s right. I’m Omar. Is this your bag?” says Omar.
